The number of days from 2022-10-13 (exclusive) to 2023-01-22 (inclusive) is 101 days.

Calculation:
- 2022-10-13 to 2022-10-31 = 18 days (exclusive of start date)
- 2022-11 = 30 days
- 2022-12 = 31 days
- 2023-01 = 22 days (inclusive of end date)

Total = 18 + 30 + 31 + 22 = **101 days**.
